ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Olexfilms uses the camera to read barcodes, QR codes and licence plates. Plates are recognized on this device; images are not sent anywhere.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Olexfilms uses Face ID for quick sign-in.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Olexfilms uses Bluetooth to connect to the paint thickness gauge (SmartPTG).
